chunks: Al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams عليهما السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who gives grain to the miller and makes an agreement with him that he give its owner ten mann of flour for every ten mann. He said: “No.”
So I said: Then a man gives sesame to the oil-presser, and he guarantees for him specified ratls for every ṣāʿ? He said: “No.”

key_terms.الطَّعَامَ: grain or foodstuff delivered for processing

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to agree on a fixed amount of flour or oil from grain or sesame given for processing?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that such fixed-output processing agreements are not permitted: grain given to a miller for an equal fixed amount of flour, and sesame given to an oil-presser for a specified fixed amount per measure. It relates to commercial dealings and the legal limits on guaranteed exchange outcomes in processing goods.
